pattern: も当然だ（もとうぜんだ）
purpose: Recognize a reaction or consequence as entirely understandable.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
give explain a reason cause result
express feelings speak politely show respect
Plain clause + のも当然だ; Vて + も当然だ
With an old map like this, it is no wonder you got lost.
After running without a break, feeling tired is only natural.
Since I forgot to contact them, it is understandable that they became anxious.
formation: Plain clause + のも当然だ; Vて + も当然だ
restrictions: のも and ても acknowledge that the consequence is natural in context.
mistake: Do not confuse 当然 “natural or expected” with 同然 “practically equivalent”.
